identificationModule.briefTitle: Treatment of Patients With Major Depressive Disorder With MK0869 (0869-061)
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Double-Blind, Multicenter, Placebo-and Active-Controlled Acute and Extension Study of 2 Doses of MK-0869 in the Treatment of Patients With Major Depressive Disorder

descriptionModule.briefSummary:
A clinical study to determine the efficacy and safety of an Treatment of MK0869

in the treatment of depression.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: The duration of treatment is 8 weeks.

primaryOutcomes.measure: HAMD-17 total score at week 8. Tolerability.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: CGI-I score at week 8, at least 50% reduction in the HAMD-17 total score, and Sheehan Disability Score at Week 8
